review_style.value: Rejects LLM output outright, fixes included; tells anyone who must use it to rely on tests
review_style.quote: We reject LLM output as a matter of course, including "fixes" included in these reports.

also.quote: LLMs are not social actors, thus you cannot rely on code review to inspect their output.

When you notice it making errors, you always have to add tests to a mechanical, deterministic harness that will evaluates the code, because the LLM cannot meaningfully learn from its mistakes outside a very small context window in the way that a human would, so giving it feedback is unhelpful.
